explanation: The base case α = ω: every graph on ω has an infinite path or an infinite independent set (any infinite subset of ω has order type ω). This is true (by Ramsey's theorem an infinite clique or infinite independent set exists, and an infinite clique contains an infinite path) and is a special case of the EHM70 result recorded on erdosproblems.com/601. The statement HasPathOrIndepSetOfType ω encodes it correctly. Faithful (essentially a textbook special case).
